title: Undo inside the page's own green line: core/ui/undo.js, ui.undoable, notices with one button, role=alert, reduced motion
change: New pure core/ui/undo.js: same, changesOf(before, after) (skips meta; rows with an id compared row by row), takeBack(draft, changes) -> {done, kept} (puts back only what still holds the value the change wrote; a removed row only if no row with its id is back; an added row only if unchanged). dom.js: export undoable(store, mutate): one store.update that takes before = store.get() inside the callback then mutates; changes = changesOf(before, store.get()); null when empty; else undo() that runs once: store.update(d => r = takeBack(d, changes)), returns r. export undoneWords(r, words). notice(kind, text, opts): kind error gets role=alert; opts.undo adds button.secondary.notice-action 'Undo' (44 px) that runs undo() then opts.undone?.(r); opts.action = {label, run} the same for any single button; class has-action. base.css: .notice.has-action (text and button on one line, wraps on a phone), .notice .notice-action; the reduced-motion block gets .fold .fold-chev, .scroll-hint::after { transition: none } (merge with the taps track's additions to the same line). Nothing position: fixed.
